title: Beneath the waves
intro: The same six continents, now with the continental crust that lies under the sea: shelves and stretched margins. It moves with the land, and it is the real edge of each continent.
questions: Fit the continents again, edge of crust to edge of crust. Is it better than the coastline fit?
Which continents gained the most hidden crust? Where is it?
Sea level has changed through time. Why does that make the coastline a poor edge to fit?
